checks.name: captured-query-is-memory-only
checks.run:
import subprocess
script="const fs=require('node:fs'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),mod={exports:{}};const source=fs.readFileSync('mission_control/static/drive-callback.js','utf8').replace(/^export /gm,'');new Function('module','globalThis',source)(mod,{});let removed=false;const browser={location:{search:'?state=drive_'+ 'a'.repeat(43)+'&code=synthetic',pathname:'/'},history:{replaceState(){removed=true}}};const result=typeof mod.exports.capture==='function'?mod.exports.capture(browser):undefined;assert.equal(result,browser.location.search.slice(1),'Capture must preserve exact query in memory');assert.equal(removed,true,'Query must be removed before use');"
r=subprocess.run(['node','-e',script],capture_output=True,text=True)
assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
